name: Y Combinator
description: Public YC startup directory: browse or search companies by batch and filters, list batches, read company profiles and advertised jobs.

tools.name: Batches
tools.description: List every batch label published in the public YC directory with its company count, newest first. Use a returned batch label as the search batch filter.

response.about: List every batch label published in the public YC directory with its company count, newest first. Use a returned batch label as the search batch filter.

tools.name: Company
tools.description: Read a public YC company profile: description, batch, location, team size, source-reported status and the founders listed on the profile (name, title, bio, LinkedIn and X/Twitter links).

response.about: Read a public YC company profile: description, batch, location, team size, source-reported status and the founders listed on the profile (name, title, bio, LinkedIn and X/Twitter links).

fields.name: founders
fields.about: Founders as listed on the public profile page; null when the profile carries no founders list.

records.long_description:
Firecrawl is the easiest way to turn the web into data AI agents can use. One API call converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data - the boring-hard problem everyone building with LLMs eventually hits, solved.

We hit 8 figures in ARR in year one and more than doubled it in year two. We have 150k+ GitHub stars, and developers, agents, and category-defining AI companies build on us every day. Growth like this is rare, and we're just getting started.

We're a small team punching far above our weight. Everyone here owns a real piece of the product and company, end to end, and runs it themselves - no hiding behind process or headcount.

This is a place for people who want to work at the frontier: an AI company building the infrastructure other AI companies run on, not one bolting AI onto an existing product. We move fast, go deep, and are building the tools superintelligence will rely on to gather data from the web.

tools.name: Jobs
tools.description: List public jobs advertised on a YC company profile, including source salary text, location, role and requirements. Each record adds best-effort structured locations, a remote/hybrid/onsite flag and ISO country codes parsed from the location text, plus the source role slug, skills, posting age, apply link and batch. No application or contact actions.

response.about: List public jobs advertised on a YC company profile, including source salary text, location, role and requirements. Each record adds best-effort structured locations, a remote/hybrid/onsite flag and ISO country codes parsed from the location text, plus the source role slug, skills, posting age, apply link and batch. No application or contact actions.

fields.name: countries
fields.about: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes from locations[].country, derived from explicit country names or US/Canadian region codes only.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.about: Source relative posting age text, e.g. 3 days.

fields.name: locations
fields.about: Places parsed from the free-text location (split on ;, / and or); empty when nothing parses. location stays the source of truth.

fields.name: remote
fields.about: Derived from the location text: remote only, hybrid (on-site places plus remote, or the word Hybrid), onsite, or null when the text does not parse.

records.location: San Francisco, US or Toronto, Canada (Preferred) OR Remote (Americas, UTC-3 to UTC-10) / Remote (US)

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Browse or search the public YC company directory. Query is optional: omit it to list every company matching the exact source labels for batch (e.g. Summer 2025), industry, region, status and tag, or the hiring, top company and nonprofit flags. Twenty entries per zero-based page, at most fifty pages.

options.name: batch
options.about: Exact batch label as published by YC, e.g. Summer 2025 or Winter 2022. Use the batches function to list valid labels.

options.name: hiring
options.about: Only companies the directory flags as hiring (true) or not hiring (false).

options.name: industry
options.about: Exact industry label, e.g. B2B, Consumer, Healthcare, Fintech.

options.name: page
options.about: Zero-based page; next_page in the output gives the following page or null when exhausted.

options.name: query
options.about: Free-text search over company names and descriptions. Omit or leave empty to browse by filters only.

options.name: region
options.about: Exact region label, e.g. America / Canada, United States of America, Europe, Remote.

options.name: tag
options.about: Exact tag label, e.g. Developer Tools, AI, Open Source.

options.name: top_company
options.about: Only companies on the YC Top Companies list.

response.about: Browse or search the public YC company directory. Twenty entries per zero-based page, at most fifty pages.
